findings.current: Do you think we’re horse caravans for nothing?
findings.defect: Omits Ma Junggeol’s slip from “mounted bandits” to “horse caravans,” losing a revealing comic beat.
findings.rationale: He starts to call his group 마적, then corrects himself to 마방.
findings.replacement: Do you think we’re mounted bandits—no, horse caravans—for nothing?
findings.source: 저희가 괜히 마적, 아니 마방(馬房)이겠습니까?

findings.current: Even now, half the leaders still suspected Ma Junggeol and the other horse-caravan men, and had effectively taken them hostage. Yet he was acting so carefree.
findings.defect: Changes “some leaders” into “half the leaders” and shifts “half-hostage” from Ma Junggeol’s condition to an apparently complete hostage-taking.
findings.rationale: 몇몇 modifies the leaders; 반쯤 modifies his hostage-like status.
findings.replacement: Even now, at the strong insistence of a few leaders who still suspected Ma Junggeol and the other horse-caravan men, he was practically being held hostage. Yet he seemed utterly carefree.
findings.source: 아직 마중걸을 비롯한 마방들을 향한 의심을 거두지 않은 몇몇 수뇌부들의 강력 주장으로 반쯤 볼모가 된 지금에도, 저리 태평한 모습을 보이고 있으니.

findings.current: “Shit, you scared me. What’s with you?”
findings.defect: Turns a clipped, mild curse into an unqualified stronger one and drops the complaint that Ma appeared suddenly.
findings.rationale: 아이, 씨 is an interrupted exclamation, and 갑자기 makes the sudden interruption explicit.
findings.replacement: “Ah, damn. You scared me. What’s with you all of a sudden?”

findings.current: “Just felt like two times would seem unfriendly.”
findings.defect: The phrasing obscures that he ordered the third volley because stopping at two might make him look cold.
findings.rationale: 두 번 하면 정 없어 보일까 봐 supplies the deliberately absurd reason for firing a third time.
findings.replacement: “Just thought stopping at two would make me look cold.”
findings.source: “그냥. 두 번 하면 정 없어 보일까 봐.”

findings.current: “Happy? How could I be? Are you even human?”
findings.defect: Answers whether Ma is happy rather than rejecting Taekyung’s claim that his explanation is finished.
findings.rationale: 되긴 뭐가 돼 directly challenges the preceding 끝. 됐죠?
findings.replacement: “What do you mean, ‘that’s it’? Are you even human?”
